label: real
title: 1,3-butadiene spike in El Paso
time_note: Monitor hours are CST as TCEQ publishes them; the company report uses local time (CST). TCEQ labels AutoGC data provisional and subject to change.

detection.rule: value >= max(10 x 7-day median baseline, 10 ppb)

record_check.search_scope: Searched every STEERS emissions event starting 12/04/2025 in El Paso County (0 found; search complete). Also searched reports that started in the 30 days before and were still running (0 open that day; earlier search complete). No matching report found in a complete search.

packet.draft_en: On December 4, 2025, the Texas state monitor at Chamizal recorded 30.46 ppb of 1,3-butadiene in the 10:00 a.m. CST hour, against a 7-day median of 0.03 ppb. Wind there came from 31 degrees at 7.8 mph. 0 major permitted facilities lie in the upwind corridor. No matching report found in a complete search of that day's emissions-event records for El Paso County. That does not show who or what caused the reading. Requested follow-up: confirm whether any facility in this corridor reported a release that hour.
packet.draft_es: El 4 de diciembre de 2025, el monitor estatal de Texas en Chamizal registró 30.46 ppb de 1,3-butadieno en la hora de las 10:00 a. m. CST, frente a una mediana de 7 días de 0.03 ppb. El viento venía de 31 grados a 7.8 mph. Hay 0 instalaciones grandes con permiso en el corredor viento arriba. No se encontró un reporte que coincida en una búsqueda completa de los registros de eventos de emisiones de ese día en el condado de El Paso. Eso no indica quién o qué causó la lectura. Seguimiento solicitado: confirmar si alguna instalación en este corredor reportó una emisión a esa hora.

cannot_say: A matching report is not proof the facility caused every reading; other sources can add to a spike.
'Not yet reported' is not a finding about any facility: Texas requires a report only at or above a reportable quantity, and air readings cannot measure how much was released (30 TAC 101.201).
The upwind corridor comes from wind direction at one monitor (geometry only), not a dispersion model; it cannot tell facilities along the same bearing apart.
Facility coordinates are as published by EPA ECHO and may be approximate.
Only regulator-grade monitors whose data the state publishes are used, never low-cost sensors.

triangulation.rule: monitors meeting the trigger rule within 1 h of the detection hour; each wedge +/-22.5 deg of its own upwind bearing, <= 15 km; narrows when the intersection keeps <= 75% of the corridor; aligned below 22.5 deg separation
